title: Minnesota lawyer suspended over fake AI case citations

reading.body:

What the headline alone indicates is that a lawyer in Minnesota received a professional suspension connected to AI-generated case citations that were fabricated. This pattern, a legal professional submitting citations to a court that do not correspond to real cases and were produced by an AI system, has appeared in other documented incidents and represents a model asserting false information as fact, with no human verification step catching the error before submission to a court.

Whether this suspension was the result of a formal disciplinary finding, what AI system was involved, the length of the suspension, and the specific cases cited are all unknown from the material provided.
